brief:
Residents of Gaza are experiencing overwhelming fatigue rather than resignation to Israeli military operations, according to We Are Not Numbers. Three new roadblocks have been erected near their hometown, adding to existing constraints on movement and daily life.

What external observers may interpret as Palestinian indifference reflects deep exhaustion from prolonged conflict and restrictions, residents say. They characterize fear and hope as the emotional currents sustaining them through conditions of ongoing strain.
dek: Three new roadblocks went up near our hometown: What outsiders read as Palestinian numbness is exhaustion. Fear and hope are how we keep going.
title: Gazans describe exhaustion, not surrender, amid new Israeli roadblocks
